prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet anytime from your system tray or keyboard shortcuts.", "Right-click pet for main menu & settings", "Press Alt+P to quickly toggle pet visibility", "Got It"]
1: ["Upload Pet Photos"]
2: ["Desktop Display Diagnostic", "Checking screen overlay permissions and multi-monitor setup to ensure smooth pet rendering.", "Verifying overlay permissions...", "Confirm Display Ready"]
3: ["Welcome to your new virtual desktop companion experience!"]
4: ["Note: Make sure to grant screen overlay permissions if prompted by your operating system."]
5: ["Claim Your Free Starter Accessories!", "Finish setup now to unlock 10 starter treats and a cozy hat for your new pet.", "Bonus 10 Treats Unlocked"]
6: ["A friendly chime will alert you the moment your pet is ready on your desktop."]
7: ["Choose Your Pet Path", "Select instant starter companion or craft a custom pet."]
8: ["Sign In to Secure Your Pet Data", "Creating an account links your pet to the cloud so your companion and progress are safely restored whenever you log in."]
9: ["Don't worry about perfection! You can rename or customize your pet anytime in settings."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and creates urgency to finish setup
